text_block_list.text: I came to the shrine with Special Week, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mmmmm...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe. You could tell?
To be honest... things have been a bit strange lately.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Having nightmares, my shoelaces coming undone
all the time... it's just been one bad thing after another...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So I figured the only thing left to do
was pray to the gods!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, please, God~!
Let something good happen next time~!

It seemed Special Week was
genuinely troubled by this.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Thank you very much!
I'm sure it'll work better than wishing alone!
I prayed together with Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew... All right, that's done. Well then, Trainer.
(Buzz, buzz)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, an email from Mom.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's amazing, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mom says she's gonna send over some delicious crab! Ehehe, looks like our prayers were answered right away!

"Special Week beamed with joy
at the immediate blessings that had come her way."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmm... Mm.
There... perfect.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, now that we've finished praying,
shall we head back—
(Coo-coo-roo~! Coo-coo-roo~!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaah!? A p-pigeon just pooped from above!?
T-Trainer-san, save meee!

...Unfortunately, it seems they were unable
to receive any divine blessings.
